intentional_adaptations.initPlugin: Registers uniquely named Lab context-menu providers in a deterministic chain after the upstream providers, and registers the independent blissmixerlab command without upstream analyser, importer, or protocol components.
intentional_adaptations.postinitPlugin: Registers Bliss (Lab) independently and applies the upstream compatibility gate.
intentional_adaptations._pathToTrack: Carries the sidecar's Windows path existence fix until it is present upstream.
intentional_adaptations._dstmMix: Owns the sidecar process, defers database refreshes during upstream analysis, and adds learned-matrix selection, play-count reranking, Last.fm similar-track guidance, blend handling, and experimental diagnostics.
intentional_adaptations._selectViaLastFm: Combines Last.fm recording and artist evidence with play-count influence over one shared candidate pool, applies a bounded deadline, and retains upstream artist-only behavior when the experimental signals are disabled.
intentional_adaptations._buildComparisonJson: Adds learnedblend overrides used by experimental comparison diagnostics.
intentional_adaptations._cliCommand: Keeps the Lab-only port and survey commands while routing interactive mix and list requests to the sidecar binary with adaptive seed settings.
intentional_adaptations._callApi: Uses the sidecar process, preserves deferred bliss.db refresh handling, and returns Lab-labelled context-menu results.
intentional_adaptations._objectInfoHandler: Uses distinct BlissMixerLab menu labels, commands, and player modes.
intentional_adaptations._trackSimilarityHandler: Uses distinct BlissMixerLab menu labels, commands, and player modes and retains by-artist mode parameters.
intentional_adaptations._getListData: Adds the upstream filter_xmas setting plus adaptiveweights and learnedblend for learned-matrix similarity lists.
